note: Tuvalu issues no national identity card: the birth certificate is its recognised legal identity document, and a digital ID system has yet to be implemented (SEAP digital ID overview).

sources.title: Institute on Statelessness and Inclusion / SEAP, Digital ID overview: Tuvalu
sources.said: In Tuvalu, the recognized legal identity document is the birth certificate. ... As the digital ID system has yet to be implemented,
